subject: RE: Renewal + expansion pricing — volume step-ups & blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@acme-health.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion pricing — volume step-ups & blended rates

Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and I can put together a formal proposal: 

- Current production usage: ~250M tokens/month (mostly chat generation + a smaller embedding route for search).
- Expected growth: plan to ramp to ~1.2B tokens/month over the next 12 months as you turn on the new personalization & summarization routes.
- Primary goal: keep unit economics predictable — you mentioned a target blended cost in the range of $30–$40 per 1M tokens as the budget envelope.
- Must-haves from procurement: SOC 2 evidence (we covered this), export controls, and a standard PO + 60-day invoice term.

Next steps I can take after you confirm the growth profile and procurement timing:
1) Send two pricing options: (A) Conservative step-up tiers with higher headroom for Q1, (B) Aggressive discounting tied to committed monthly volumes and blended rate guarantees.
2) Include a blended-rate example and a simple mutual action plan (MAP) so we’re tracking approvals and signatures.
3) Call out how adding the new embedding/classification route (we discussed model X-embed) impacts KV caching and billing — I’ll include model-specific guidance.

I’ve attached a short pricing options doc with starter tiers to frame the conversation (redwood-q1-2026-pricing-options.pdf). If the $30–$40/1M target is the primary constraint, say so and I’ll prioritize achieving a blended rate near the mid-point of that band in the proposal.

Proposed timeline: draft proposal by EOD Thursday if you confirm growth and procurement timing today.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the assumptions:
- Current baseline ~250M monthly.
- Business case expects ~1.2B/month peak by month 12 (gradual ramp every quarter).
- Target budget band for procurement is $30–$40 per 1M tokens; leadership prefers leaner unit economics if we can preserve quality.

Procurement timing: we’re aiming to get a signed agreement before the end of March. Procurement team needs the proposal (with PO terms and SOC2 statements) to review two weeks prior to signature.

Two asks for your proposal:
1) Can you include a simple blended-rate example at 1.2B tokens (show both step-up pricing and blended effective $/1M)?
2) We want an option that adds the new embedding route as a separately-metered line item (so we can evaluate impact independently).

If you can get a draft by Thursday EOD that contains both items and the MAP, we’ll review and route internally.

Thanks —
Alex
Head of Product, Acme Health

Alex —

Attached is the draft proposal and a quick pricing-calculation workbook (redwood-q1-2026-proposal-acme.pdf, redwood-pricing-calculation-sheet.xlsx). Highlights / two configurable approaches: 

Option A — Committed step-up tiers (recommended for predictability):
- 0–250M: $45 / 1M tokens
- 250M–1B: $30 / 1M tokens
- >1B: $20 / 1M tokens

At a 1.2B monthly run-rate, that steps to a blended effective rate of ~$26 / 1M tokens (illustrated in the attached calc sheet).

Option B — Blended guaranteed (requires a 12-month commit):
- Guaranteed blended rate: $28 / 1M tokens at 1.2B (fixed), includes separate metering for the new embedding route (embed route priced at $35 / 1M tokens as a line item).

Other notes: 
- We can add an addendum to explicitly name model variants (e.g., gen-4.1 / gen-embed-1) and cap prices for those routes to avoid surprise shifts.
- SOC 2 and export control docs are included in the secure link in the proposal.

Suggested MAP (high level):
1) Acme confirms growth profile (you) — by Fri 2/27
2) Redwood sends final contract + DocuSign — by Thu 3/4
3) Procurement review + PO issuance — target week of 3/8
4) Contract effective date aimed for 3/22

I’ll hold Option B pricing pending finance approval on the blended guarantee (I expect to have sign-off by EOD Tuesday). If you want to preserve the PO cadence, I can send a redline-friendly contract that matches Option A today and we can convert to Option B after commit.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-ACME-2026-03
DocuSign (draft) — https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DEF-ACME-2026-03

Let me know which option you want prioritized and I’ll push the final docs to DocuSign.

Best,
